discovery.area: B1 United States (federal), European Union, United Kingdom; B2 US states (since 2026-11-16)
discovery.summary: One material federal change: BIS interim final rule "Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors" (91 FR 74970, effective 19 Nov 2026) formally rescinds the AI Diffusion Rule (removing the model-weight control ECCN 4E091 and country tiers) and adds licence requirements for overseas data centres serving D:5/Macau-headquartered companies and for five diversion-risk countries; drafted as a change to bis. No new AI executive order (FR API: presidential documents since 10 Nov are unrelated). EU: AI Board (18 Nov) adopted new rules of procedure and the Advisory Forum (16 Nov) elected co-chairs — no new AI Act instrument. UK: no AI bill; the UK-EU summit (20 Nov) only announces an intended Digital Partnership in 2027. States: Massachusetts H.5576 (Mass Wins) still shows only the 30 Jul conference-committee appointment on malegislature.gov, so the 16 Nov conference reports remain unverified; no other state frontier statute enacted; NY DIGIT and Colorado AG pages show nothing beyond last run.

discovery.area: B3 multilateral bodies and processes; industry and multistakeholder bodies (since 2026-11-16)
discovery.summary: No new multilateral instrument. The Élysée has now published the Paris Call for AI Safety and Security with an authoritative signatory list (19 governments, 11 companies, 11 civil-society bodies; "remains open to new endorsements"), which settles the Dutch/Canadian discrepancy noted for P-0196 — logged for the lead to revise that flag. CoE Convention parties table unchanged (EU, Bosnia and Herzegovina ratified; not in force). AISR publications unchanged (Feb 2026); Geneva AI Summit 21-22 Jun 2027 unchanged (ITU 18 Nov item); UN Global Dialogue page latest item is the 16 Oct co-chair appointment; NAAIMES no new output (AISI blog latest 26 Oct). FMF latest is the 5 Nov Jailbreak Rating Framework (P-0195); PAI latest 8 Oct; GPAI Code signatory page last updated 7 Oct.

Drafted two prep changes. No new framework versions: RSP v3.4 (page updated 14 Aug), FSF v3.1, Meta v2.1 (P-0149), xAI 30 Jun 2026 edition. Apollo's 16 Nov pilot post corroborates the embedded arrangement. CAIS 18 Nov coalition statement against Anthropic is advocacy.
